properties.name: iyakki:origin
properties.value: the logo: the owner's picture dist/brand/owner-logo.png (brushed-steel arrow heads with blue circuit light), cut out of its grey background and centred in a 384 pixel square by dist/brand/make-brand-assets.py (no model, fixed numbers, numpy and Pillow); the picture was made by the owner with Google Gemini (owner statement, 2026-10-31); replaced the earlier emblem drawn by the same script (git history has it)

properties.name: iyakki:origin
